title: New York Is Set to Take On Amazon Over Drivers, if Its Leaders Can Agree
summary: Mayor Zohran Mamdani backs a bill to stop Amazon from outsourcing its deliveries, which would be a blow to the company. The City Council speaker, Julie Menin, and business leaders have concerns.
